Scryer is a self-hosted media management application written in Rust, designed to efficiently handle movies, TV series, and anime. It automates the process of monitoring libraries, searching for releases, evaluating quality, coordinating downloads, organizing files, and managing subtitles, all within a single, compiled binary.
